business_summary: CIMC Vehicles (Group) Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, sells, and services semi-trailers worldwide. The company engages in the wholesale and retail of vehicles, auto parts, and metal materials; processing and manufacture of general mechanical products; and metal structures and related businesses. It also provides chassis, tractors, related spare parts, trailers and accessories, auto parts, containers, folding containers, tank containers, composite material products, tank trucks, and automobile trailers. In addition, the company develops, produces, and sells various special vehicles, modified vehicles, transport vehicles, mechanical products, and metal structure parts. Further, it engages in the sale of automobiles, trams, auto parts, metal materials, hardware products, electronic equipment, mechanical equipment, and chemical products; import and export of goods and technologies; operation of highways and parking lots; land freight transportation; domestic freight forwarding; and leasing of machinery equipment, vehicles, and containers. Additionally, the company is involved in the development, construction, operation, leasing, and sale of warehousing and supporting facilities; property management and investment business; inspection of motor vehicles; and vehicle storage, warehousing, computer software, and logistics activities, as well as provides technical consulting services. It markets and sells its products under the CIMC Lighthouse, Vanguard, CIE, SDC, LAG, Ruijiang Tanker, and Tonghua Tanker brands. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Tianda Heavy Industries Ltd. and changed its name to CIMC Vehicles (Group) Co., Ltd. in May 2005. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: CIMC Vehicles (Group) Co., Ltd.는 전 세계적으로 세미트레일러를 설계, 제조, 판매 및 서비스합니다. 회사는 자동차, 자동차 부품, 금속재료 등의 도소매업을 영위하고 있습니다. 일반 기계제품의 가공 및 제조; 금속 구조물 및 관련 사업. 또한 섀시, 트랙터, 관련 예비 부품, 트레일러 및 액세서리, 자동차 부품, 컨테이너, 접이식 컨테이너, 탱크 컨테이너, 복합 재료 제품, 탱크 트럭 및 자동차 트레일러를 제공합니다. 이 밖에도 각종 특수차량, 개조차량, 운송차량, 기계제품, 금속구조부품을 개발, 생산, 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 자동차, 트램, 자동차 부품, 금속 재료, 하드웨어 제품, 전자 장비, 기계 장비 및 화학 제품의 판매에 종사합니다. 상품 및 기술의 수입 및 수출; 고속도로 및 주차장 운영; 육상 화물 운송; 국내 화물운송; 기계 장비, 차량 및 컨테이너 임대. 또한 회사는 창고 및 지원 시설의 개발, 건설, 운영, 임대 및 판매에 참여합니다. 소유하다
